packages.title: 10 Days - Sri Lanka Dream Route
packages.subtitle: Ancient Cities, Hills & Beaches
packages.card_alt: Aerial view of Sigiriya Rock Fortress rising above the lush Sri Lankan landscape
packages.hero_alt: Cinematic view of Sri Lanka's cultural triangle and tropical landscapes at sunrise
packages.card_description: A 10-day tailor-made route through Negombo, Anuradhapura, Sigiriya, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Yala, Bentota, and Colombo.
packages.overview: Sri Lanka is perfect for couples relax on stunning beaches, explore misty hills and waterfalls, or go on adventures through rainforests and mountains. Try water sports, wildlife safaris, and village life, then unwind with a luxurious spa after a day of fun and flavor.

highlights.title: Negombo
highlights.description: Begin by the coast with lagoon rides, fishing village life, colonial churches, and a relaxed beach-town welcome.

highlights.title: Anuradhapura
highlights.description: Explore Sri Lanka's first kingdom, sacred stupas, Mihintale, and a Wilpattu safari woven into the cultural heartland.

highlights.title: Sigiriya
highlights.description: Climb Sigiriya and Pidurangala, then pair the rock-fortress landscapes with a Minneriya wildlife safari.

highlights.title: Kandy
highlights.description: Move into the hill capital for temple visits, spice gardens, batik workshops, botanical gardens, and Kandyan culture.

highlights.title: Nuwara Eliya
highlights.description: Experience tea country, Ramboda Falls, Seetha Amman Kovil, Gregory Lake, and classic high-tea ambience in the cool highlands.

highlights.title: Yala
highlights.description: Bridge Ella viewpoints and Nine Arches scenery with a leopard-focused safari through Sri Lanka's most iconic national park.

highlights.title: Bentota & Kalutara
highlights.description: Slow the pace on the southwest coast with Galle Fort, Madu River, turtle conservation, beaches, and water sports.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Negombo Arrival
itinerary.description: Arrive at the airport and transfer to Negombo for St. Mary's Church, a Hamilton Canal boat ride, fishing-village encounters, and a sunset beach evening.
details: Travel Time: Airport to Hotel - 15 Minutes

itinerary.title: Day 02: Anuradhapura & Wilpattu
itinerary.description: Travel north after breakfast for a half-day Wilpattu jeep safari, then continue into the sacred city for ancient temple and Mihintale explorations.
details: Travel Time: Negombo to Anuradhapura - 4 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 03: Sigiriya Stronghold
itinerary.description: Head to Sigiriya to climb Lion Rock and Pidurangala, then round out the day with a Minneriya safari and a traditional village boat ride.
details: Travel Time: Anuradhapura to Sigiriya - 2 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 04: Kandy Heritage
itinerary.description: Drive via Dambulla into Kandy, visiting spice gardens, the Royal Botanical Garden, local batik and handicraft makers, gem workshops, and the Temple of the Tooth.
details: Travel Time: Sigiriya to Kandy - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 05: Nuwara Eliya Tea Country
itinerary.description: Climb into the central highlands for Hanuman Temple, Ramboda Falls, tea country stops, Seetha Amman Kovil, Gregory Lake, and high tea in Nuwara Eliya.
details: Travel Time: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 06: Ella Corridor to Yala
itinerary.description: Travel through the hill-country edge to Nine Arches Bridge and Little Adam's Peak before continuing to Yala for an evening safari and wildlife tracking.
details: Travel Time: Nuwara Eliya to Yala - 4 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 07-08: South Coast Escape
itinerary.description: Continue toward Bentota and Kalutara for Rumassala, stilt fishermen, Galle Fort, a Madu River safari, Lunuganga Estate, Kosgoda turtle hatchery, beach time, and water sports.
details: Travel Time: Yala to Bentota - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 09-10: Colombo & Departure
itinerary.description: Finish in Colombo with Gangaramaya Temple, Pettah and Fort landmarks, shopping, Galle Face Green, and an airport drop on the final day.
details: Travel Time: Bentota to Colombo - 2 Hours

packages.title: A 12-Day Island Adventure Awaits
packages.subtitle: Grand Island Discovery
packages.card_alt: The iconic blue train crossing the Nine Arch Bridge in Ella, surrounded by lush green tea bushes and tropical forest
packages.hero_alt: Misty tea plantation in Ella with mountain ridges in the background
packages.card_description: A 12-day island-wide route through Negombo, Sigiriya, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Yala, Wadduwa, and Colombo.
packages.overview: This island-wide journey opens with Negombo's easy coastal arrival before moving through Sigiriya's ancient citadels, Kandy's sacred heritage, the cool tea country of Nuwara Eliya, Yala's wildlife frontier, and a restorative west-coast finish. The route balances cultural landmarks, light adventure, scenic rail and road transitions, safari time, and relaxed city exploration so the island feels broad without becoming rushed.

highlights.title: Negombo Arrival
highlights.description: Ease into Sri Lanka with a short airport transfer, beachfront downtime, local markets, canal-town atmosphere, and a gentle first sunset by the coast.

highlights.title: Sigiriya & Polonnaruwa
highlights.description: Spend two full days around Lion Rock, village scenery, and the ruins of Polonnaruwa, with time for sunset views and classic Cultural Triangle landmarks.

highlights.title: Kandy Heritage
highlights.description: Shift into the hill capital for Dambulla Cave Temple, the Temple of the Tooth, Peradeniya gardens, market walks, and Kandyan cultural performances.

highlights.title: Tea Country Interlude
highlights.description: Nuwara Eliya adds the island's cool-climate contrast with scenic train travel, tea estates, Horton Plains options, and elegant high-tea moments.

highlights.title: Yala & South Coast
highlights.description: Continue via Ella into Yala for a safari, then slow down in Wadduwa with stilt-fishermen stops, beach afternoons, and spa-oriented coast time.

highlights.title: Colombo Finish
highlights.description: Close the trip in Colombo with cultural sights, shopping, street life, and a final urban contrast before departure.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Negombo Arrival
itinerary.description: Arrive in Sri Lanka and settle into Negombo, where the first day is intentionally light with hotel check-in, time to unwind by the beach, and an easy introduction to island life.
details: Travel Time: Airport to Negombo - 30 Minutes

itinerary.title: Days 02-03: Sigiriya & Polonnaruwa
itinerary.description: Travel inland to Sigiriya for Lion Rock, sunset viewpoints, and a second day dedicated to the ancient city of Polonnaruwa, with village experiences and optional wildlife time around Minneriya.
details: Accommodation: Habarana Village by Cinnamon (4 Hotel)
Travel Time: Negombo to Sigiriya - 3 Hours 3 Minutes

itinerary.title: Days 04-05: Kandy Cultural Capital
itinerary.description: Continue to Kandy via Dambulla Cave Temple, then spend time with the Temple of the Tooth, the Royal Botanic Gardens, the local market, and an evening Kandyan dance performance.
details: Travel Time: Sigiriya to Kandy - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 06-07: Nuwara Eliya Tea Country
itinerary.description: Move into the central highlands with a scenic train journey, tea-country views, high tea, and optional Horton Plains exploration before another unhurried evening in the hills.
details: Travel Time: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya - 4 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 08: Ella to Yala
itinerary.description: Drive south with an Ella stopover and then head into safari country for a half-day game drive in Yala National Park, known for leopards, elephants, and birdlife.
details: Travel Time: Nuwara Eliya to Yala - 4 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 09-10: Wadduwa Coast Break
itinerary.description: Trade the bush for the beach as you move to Wadduwa, pausing for stilt fishermen and Coconut Tree Hill, then spend a full day on the coast with beach relaxation and spa-style downtime.
details: Accommodation: The Blue Water Hotel (5 Hotel)
Travel Time: Yala to Wadduwa - 3 Hours 30 Minutes

itinerary.title: Day 11-12: Colombo & Departure
itinerary.description: Finish in Colombo with a city-focused final chapter covering temples, museums, shopping, and street life before your onward transfer.
details: Travel Time: Wadduwa to Colombo - 1 Hour

gallery.alt: Blue train crossing Nine Arch Bridge in Ella

packages.title: 14 Days - Sri Lanka Intimate Trails
packages.subtitle: Slow Luxury Across the Island
packages.card_alt: Traditional stilt fishermen at sunset in Weligama bay
packages.hero_alt: Pristine turquoise beach in Mirissa with palm trees and golden sand
packages.card_description: A slow 14-day route through Negombo, Sigiriya, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Tangalle, and Colombo.
packages.overview: Built around slower pacing and boutique stays, this route gives Sri Lanka's headline regions more breathing room. Negombo opens gently, Sigiriya expands into a three-night cultural stay, Kandy and Nuwara Eliya bring quieter heritage and hill-country luxury, Tangalle focuses on beach and birdlife, and the final Galle-Colombo segment finishes with architecture, shopping, and relaxed urban exploration.

highlights.title: Boutique Slow Travel
highlights.description: Each chapter leans into smaller hotels, softer pacing, and more free time rather than packing every day with transfers and checklists.

highlights.title: Sigiriya Depth
highlights.description: Negombo gives way to a longer Sigiriya stay with Lion Rock, Pidurangala, Minneriya, and Polonnaruwa instead of a rushed Cultural Triangle pass-through.

highlights.title: Hill-Country Ease
highlights.description: Kandy and Nuwara Eliya focus on scenic rail, tea estates, gardens, and refined highland experiences with room to linger.

highlights.title: Tangalle & Galle
highlights.description: The southern finale mixes quiet beaches, turtle and birdlife encounters, Galle Fort sunsets, and a polished Colombo send-off.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Negombo
itinerary.description: Arrive and settle into Negombo with time for local streets, markets, and a beach sunset, keeping the opening intentionally gentle after the flight.
details: Travel Time: Airport to Negombo - 40 Minutes

itinerary.title: Days 02-04: Sigiriya Retreat
itinerary.description: Travel to Sigiriya for a longer cultural stay that layers in the Negombo fish market, panoramic Pidurangala, Minneriya safari time, Polonnaruwa's archaeological core, and the climb up Sigiriya Rock.
details: Accommodation: Habarana Village by Cinnamon (4 Hotel)
Travel Time: Negombo to Sigiriya - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 05-06: Kandy
itinerary.description: Continue to Kandy for the Temple of the Tooth, city walks, market browsing, Suriyakantha Centre for Art & Culture, and unhurried time in the Royal Botanic Gardens.
details: Travel Time: Sigiriya to Kandy - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 07-08: Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Take the scenic hill-country train toward Nuwara Eliya, enjoy high tea at the Grand Hotel, and optionally explore Horton Plains and a traditional tea factory.
details: Travel Time: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya - 4 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 09-10: Tangalle
itinerary.description: Leave the highlands for the south coast, stopping at the Elephant Transit Home before settling into Tangalle for beach sunsets, Kalametiya birdlife, and sea-turtle viewing.
details: Accommodation: Turtle Bay Boutique Hotel (Boutique Hotel)
Travel Time: Nuwara Eliya to Tangalle - 5 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 11-12: Galle Fort Stay
itinerary.description: Move on to Galle for a quieter coastal heritage chapter, with time at the hotel, independent exploration, and a sunset walk along the ramparts of Galle Fort.
details: Accommodation: The Merchant Galle Fort (Boutique Hotel)
Travel Time: Tangalle to Galle - 2 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 13-14: Colombo Close
itinerary.description: The final chapter shifts into Colombo for Lunuganga Estate, a guided city walk, mall and boutique shopping, and a polished end to the journey before departure.
details: Travel Time: Galle to Colombo - 2 Hours 30 Minutes

packages.title: 6 Days - Tropical Trails
packages.subtitle: Culture, Coast & Highlands
packages.card_alt: A wild leopard resting on a granite rock formation in Yala National Park
packages.hero_alt: Leopard walking through the grass in Yala National Park at dusk
packages.card_description: A compact route from Sigiriya to Trincomalee, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, and Colombo.
packages.overview: This six-day family-friendly route combines Sri Lanka's cultural heartland with the east coast, hill-country heritage, and a compact Colombo finish. It opens around Sigiriya's village life and rock-fortress drama, swings out to Trincomalee for beaches and marine options, then returns through Kandy and Nuwara Eliya before ending with an urban capital contrast.

highlights.title: Sigiriya Opening
highlights.description: Start with village life, boat and bullock-cart experiences, Lion Rock, and optional Minneriya safari time in the Cultural Triangle.

highlights.title: Trincomalee Coast
highlights.description: The east-coast chapter adds Fort Frederick, Koneswaram Kovil, Pigeon Island, and Nilaveli's beach-and-snorkeling appeal.

highlights.title: Kandy Heritage
highlights.description: Kandy brings temples, spice gardens, gems, batik and handicraft stops, and a classic cultural-show evening.

highlights.title: Hill Country & Colombo
highlights.description: Nuwara Eliya cools the pace with waterfalls, Gregory Lake, and tea-country scenery before the route finishes with Colombo landmarks and shopping.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Sigiriya Village & Fortress
itinerary.description: Arrive and transfer straight to Sigiriya for village encounters, traditional transport experiences, Lion Rock, and optional wildlife viewing in Minneriya.
details: Accommodation: Habarana Village by Cinnamon (4 Hotel)
Travel Time: Airport to Sigiriya - 3 Hours & 15 minutes

itinerary.title: Day 02: Trincomalee & Nilaveli
itinerary.description: Continue east to Trincomalee for Fort Frederick, Koneswaram Kovil, optional whale watching, Pigeon Island snorkeling, and time on one of Sri Lanka's finest beaches.
details: Accommodation: Trinco Blu by Cinnamon (4 Hotel)
Travel Time: Sigiriya to Trincomalee - 2 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 03: Kandy Cultural Day
itinerary.description: Head inland to Kandy for spice experiences, the Temple of the Tooth, the Royal Botanic Gardens, gem and craft stops, and an optional traditional cultural show.
details: Travel Time: Trincomalee to Kandy - 5 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 04: Nuwara Eliya Highlands
itinerary.description: Travel into the central hills with an optional scenic train ride, Ramboda Falls, Seetha Amman Kovil, and an evening walk around Gregory Lake.
details: Travel Time: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 05-06: Colombo Finish
itinerary.description: Drop down to Colombo for Gangaramaya Temple, Fort bazaar, the Red Mosque, Galle Face Green, Old Parliament, and a shopping-heavy final city chapter before departure.
details: Travel Time: Nuwara Eliya to Colombo - 5 Hours

packages.title: 5 Romantic Days in Paradise
packages.subtitle: City, Hills & Beach for Couples
packages.card_alt: Historic Dutch colonial lighthouse in Galle Fort under a dramatic sunset sky
packages.hero_alt: Aerial view of Galle Fort lighthouse and the surrounding ocean at dusk
packages.card_description: A couples route through Colombo, Kandy, Galle, and Bentota with heritage and beach downtime.
packages.overview: This couple-focused short break is shaped around mood rather than mileage. Colombo opens with skyline dining and city culture, Kandy adds sacred heritage and garden walks, and the south-coast finish in Galle and Bentota shifts into beach time, spa moments, river cruising, and quiet romantic pauses.

highlights.title: Colombo Romance
highlights.description: Begin with Gangaramaya Temple, Green Path art, boutique shopping, skyline views, and a heritage hotel by the sea.

highlights.title: Kandy for Two
highlights.description: The middle chapter combines the Temple of the Tooth, storyteller-led walks, and Peradeniya's botanical calm.

highlights.title: Galle Interlude
highlights.description: On the southbound transfer, Galle Fort adds cobbled streets, seafood, and colonial-era atmosphere before the beach stay begins.

highlights.title: Bentota Slowdown
highlights.description: Bentota closes the route with beach relaxation, turtle conservation, Lunuganga, spa time, and intimate river-and-sunset moments.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Colombo
itinerary.description: Arrive in Colombo for Gangaramaya Temple, Green Path's open-air art, boutique shopping, and an easy first night framed by the city skyline and oceanfront heritage.
details: Travel Time: Airport to Colombo - 45 min (approx.)

itinerary.title: Day 02: Kandy
itinerary.description: Travel inland to Kandy for the Temple of the Tooth, a guided walk through hidden corners of the city, and time among the palms and avenues of the Royal Botanic Gardens.
details: Travel Time: Colombo to Kandy - 3.5 hours

itinerary.title: Day 03: Galle to Bentota
itinerary.description: Drive south with a tea-factory stop and a walk inside Galle Fort before reaching Bentota for a more relaxed coastal chapter.
details: Accommodation: Nyne Hotels Rock Villa (Boutique Hotel)
Travel Time: Kandy to Bentota - 4.5 hours

itinerary.title: Day 04-05: Bentota Beach Stay
itinerary.description: Use the coast for a softer finish with beach time, a turtle hatchery visit, Lunuganga Garden, spa and wellness options, and calm river and sunset experiences before departure.
details: Accommodation: Nyne Hotels Rock Villa (Boutique Hotel)
Travel Time: Bentota stay - local touring

packages.overview: This short break is designed for travelers who want two classic Sri Lankan contrasts without covering the whole island. Kandy delivers temple heritage, lake-city scenery, and hill-country calm, then Colombo adds markets, monuments, nightlife, and a more urban final day before departure.

highlights.title: Kandy Heritage
highlights.description: The first day is centered on the Temple of the Tooth, a city tour, and the quieter cultural rhythm of Sri Lanka's hill capital.

highlights.title: Garden & Tea Stops
highlights.description: Royal Botanic Gardens and Giragama Tea Factory make the transfer south more scenic and rooted in local character.

highlights.title: Colombo Contrast
highlights.description: Colombo brings the Red Mosque, Gangaramaya, Independence Square, Lotus Tower, and the busier energy of the capital.

highlights.title: Practical Short Route
highlights.description: The itinerary keeps hotel changes minimal and still covers one cultural city and one urban capital in just a few days.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Kandy
itinerary.description: Arrive and transfer to Kandy for a city tour, the Temple of the Tooth, and a first-night stay in the cultural capital.
details: Travel Time: Airport to Kandy - 3 hours (approx.)

itinerary.title: Day 02: Kandy to Colombo
itinerary.description: Visit the Royal Botanic Gardens and Giragama Tea Factory on the way to Colombo, then continue with a capital-city tour through its religious, civic, and nightlife landmarks.
details: Travel Time: Kandy to Colombo - 3 hours (approx.)

itinerary.title: Day 03: Departure

packages.title: 8 Days - Rhythms of Ceylon
packages.subtitle: Cultural Heritage & Scenic Wonders
packages.card_alt: Sri Lanka cultural route with scenic transitions
packages.hero_alt: Cultural and scenic Sri Lanka journey
packages.card_description: An 8-day blend of Sigiriya, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, the south, and Colombo.
packages.overview: This classic overland route strings together Sri Lanka's strongest contrasts in one balanced loop: Sigiriya's ancient fortress landscapes, Kandy's living heritage, Nuwara Eliya's tea country, Yala's safari terrain, Bentota's river-and-beach chapter, and Colombo's urban finale. It is a compact island sampler that still leaves space for landmark experiences at each stop.

highlights.title: Sigiriya Start
highlights.description: Open strong with Lion Rock, Pidurangala, village life, and a Minneriya safari in the Cultural Triangle.

highlights.title: Kandy Core
highlights.description: Kandy adds Dambulla, spice gardens, the Temple of the Tooth, gems, gardens, and cultural-performance energy.

highlights.title: Nuwara Eliya & Ella
highlights.description: Tea-country roads, Ramboda Falls, Gregory Lake, and the rail-linked Ella transition keep the middle of the trip scenic.

highlights.title: Yala Wildlife
highlights.description: A safari chapter introduces leopard country and southern dry-zone landscapes before the coast begins.

highlights.title: Bentota & Colombo
highlights.description: The trip closes with Galle Fort, Madu River, turtles, water sports, and a final Colombo city tour and shopping stop.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Arrive and head inland for Sigiriya Rock, Pidurangala, village encounters, a traditional boat ride, and safari time in Minneriya.
details: Travel Time: Airport to Sigiriya - 3 Hours & 15 minutes

itinerary.title: Day 02: Kandy
itinerary.description: Travel to Kandy via Dambulla and a spice village, then continue with the Temple of the Tooth, gem and garden visits, and an optional cultural show.
details: Travel Time: Sigiriya to Kandy - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 03: Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Climb into the highlands for Ramboda Falls, Seetha Amman Kovil, a tea-garden stop, high tea at the Grand Hotel, and sunset by Gregory Lake.
details: Travel Time: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 04: Ella to Yala
itinerary.description: Take the southbound scenic section through Ella with a train ride and Nine Arch Bridge before continuing to Yala for a 3-4 hour safari in leopard country.
details: Travel Time: Nuwara Eliya to Yala - 4 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 05-06: Bentota
itinerary.description: Shift to the southwest coast for stilt fishermen, Galle Fort, the Madu River safari, fish therapy, Lunuganga Estate, turtle conservation, water sports, and sunset beach time.
details: Travel Time: Yala to Bentota - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 07-08: Colombo & Departure
itinerary.description: Finish in Colombo with Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, shopping districts, Galle Face Green, Old Parliament, and a final overnight before departure.
details: Travel Time: Bentota to Colombo - approximately 2 Hours

packages.title: 12 Dreamy Honeymoon Days
packages.subtitle: Romance & Adventure Across Sri Lanka
packages.card_description: A luxury honeymoon route through Negombo, Dambulla, the highlands, safari country, and the south coast.
packages.overview: This honeymoon route is built around mood changes as much as geography: a soft Negombo arrival, intimate Dambulla and Sigiriya experiences, a quieter hill-country stay in Pussellawa, Ella viewpoints, Yala safari excitement, and a sensual south-coast close in Galle. It mixes landmark sightseeing with private-feeling hotels, scenic pauses, and experiences designed to feel romantic rather than rushed.

highlights.title: Romantic Openings
highlights.description: Negombo and Dambulla focus on easy arrivals, boutique luxury, sunset moments, temple stops, and intimate time together before the pace picks up.

highlights.title: Sigiriya & Polonnaruwa
highlights.description: The cultural core brings Sigiriya, Pidurangala, Polonnaruwa, and optional Minneriya safari experiences with luxurious stays around the fortress landscape.

highlights.title: Pussellawa Hills
highlights.description: Several nights in Pussellawa allow tea experiences, waterfalls, Kotmale viewpoints, Ramayana-linked sites, and quieter boutique-hotel time.

highlights.title: Ella & Yala
highlights.description: Nine Arch Bridge, Ella Swing, Rawana Pool Club, and a jeep safari in Yala add the route's most adventurous chapter.

highlights.title: Galle Coastline
highlights.description: Mirissa, stilt fishermen, Galle Fort walks, Dutch-era architecture, seafood, and sundowner rampart views shape the romantic finale.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Negombo
itinerary.description: Arrive and transfer to Kotugoda-Negombo for a gentle first evening, with time for canal-country atmosphere, Little Rome landmarks, or simple rest after arrival.
details: Travel Time: Airport to Negombo - 20 min

itinerary.title: Days 02-04: Dambulla & Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Move into the Cultural Triangle via Ridi Viharaya, then spend several days around Sigiriya Rock, Pidurangala, Polonnaruwa, and optional Minneriya safari experiences with plenty of romantic downtime at the hotel.
details: Travel Time: Negombo to Dambulla - 4 hours

itinerary.title: Days 05-07: Pussellawa Hills
itinerary.description: Travel through Kandy into the central highlands for the Temple of the Tooth, Peradeniya gardens, tea-plucker experiences, Geradigini Ella Falls, Kotmale, Chariot Path, Kadadora Temple, and slower boutique-hotel days in the hills.
details: Travel Time: Dambulla to Pussellawa - 4.5 hours (approx.)

itinerary.title: Day 08: Ella to Yala
itinerary.description: Drive via Nuwara Eliya and take the scenic train stretch into Ella for Nine Arch Bridge, the giant swing, and a Rawana Pool Club stop before continuing south to Yala.
details: Travel Time: Pussellawa to Yala - 5.5 hours

itinerary.title: Day 09: Yala Safari
itinerary.description: Dedicate the day to Yala National Park with a jeep safari, wildlife viewing, and a wilder romantic change of mood built around the park's leopard and elephant habitats.

itinerary.title: Days 10-11: Galle Romance
itinerary.description: Head for the south coast through Mirissa and Ahangama, then settle into Galle for fort walks, Dutch Reformed Church, sundowners on the ramparts, seafood, and easy beach time.
details: Travel Time: Yala to Galle - 3 hours

itinerary.title: Day 12: Departure
itinerary.description: Use the final day for a calm breakfast and onward transfer after the Galle stay.
details: Travel Time: Based on onward departure

itinerary.title: Days 01-02: Sigiriya

itinerary.title: Day 03: Kandy

itinerary.title: Days 04-05: Bentota

packages.title: 6 Days - Island Charm Express
packages.subtitle: Romantic Highlights in Fast Motion
packages.hero_alt: Sigiriya, tea country, and safari route in Sri Lanka
packages.card_description: A six-day express route through Sigiriya, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Yala, and the south.
packages.overview: This fast-moving romantic circuit compresses several of Sri Lanka's signature landscapes into one efficient overland route. It begins with Sigiriya's fortress country, crosses through Kandy and the tea highlands, turns into Ella and Yala for scenery plus wildlife, and closes on the southwest coast around Bentota and Galle.

highlights.title: Sigiriya for Couples
highlights.description: Open with Lion Rock, Pidurangala, village life, and optional Minneriya wildlife in one of the island's most dramatic landscapes.

highlights.title: Kandy Heritage
highlights.description: Kandy introduces temples, spices, botanic gardens, gems, and cultural performance into the route's romantic middle section.

highlights.title: Tea-Country Views
highlights.description: Nuwara Eliya brings waterfalls, tea estates, Seetha Amman Kovil, Gregory Lake, and the cool-air contrast of the central highlands.

highlights.title: Yala to Bentota
highlights.description: The southbound half blends Ella viewpoints, safari country, Galle's fort heritage, Madu River mangroves, and a softer beach close.

itinerary.title: Day 01: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Arrive and head to Sigiriya for Pinnawala, Lion Rock, Pidurangala, village experiences, and optional Minneriya wildlife encounters.
details: Accommodation: Habarana Village by Cinnamon (4 Hotel)
Travel Time: Airport to Sigiriya - 3 Hours & 15 minutes

itinerary.title: Day 02: Kandy
itinerary.description: Continue into Kandy for spice-village visits, the Royal Botanic Gardens, gem experiences, a cultural show, and the Temple of the Tooth.
details: Travel Time: Sigiriya to Kandy - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 03: Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Climb into tea country with Hanuman Temple, Ramboda Falls, Labukale tea gardens, Seetha Amman Kovil, and sunset by Gregory Lake.
details: Travel Time: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya - 3 Hours

itinerary.title: Day 04: Ella to Yala
itinerary.description: Travel via Nine Arches Bridge, Little Adam's Peak, and the Ella Gap before reaching Yala for safari-country landscapes and wildlife options.
details: Travel Time: Nuwara Eliya to Yala - 4 Hours

itinerary.title: Days 05-06: Bentota & Departure
itinerary.description: End on the southwest coast with Galle Dutch Fort, the Maritime Archaeology Museum, Madu River mangroves, Kosgoda turtle conservation, and a calmer beach-and-water-sports finale.
details: Travel Time: Yala to Bentota - 3 Hours
